category_title: Respectful and self-regulated learners who internalize school values
scenario_title: Addressing disruptive behavior and control-seeking in class
minimal_context: The student is working on a class assignment among other students in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please continue working on your class assignment quietly at your desks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leans over to the next desk) Give me your paper, I'll tell you how to do it. I'm in control of everybody here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit back down and focus on your own assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't need to sit down. I'm a big man, I can check on what they are doing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to keep the classroom quiet for everyone.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Loudly disturbing others) Listen to me, everyone! I'm the big man and I'm in control, so you all need to do exactly what I say!
